_comment: Cost model and mapping policy of npu-hybrid (include/npu/Transforms/Hybrid.h). NPU values follow the simulator settings (800 MHz, 4 cores, 32x32 array); PIM values follow lp6-pim-main configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_2CH.ini (2400 MHz, 8 PUs x 4 lanes, 2 subchannels x 2 ranks, nLLD 10 CK). npu.lp6_read_gbps, pim.efficiency and the boundary costs (act_write_*, readback_*, gemv_fixed_us) are starting values carried over from hybrid-compiler/configs/target.json (fitted there to that compiler's code on 2026-09-26/29); they are not from the LPDDR6-PIM PDF and are to be refitted to this compiler's runs. pim.concurrent_ranks is false because the draft defines no rank-to-rank rule for PIM compute: a PIM phase runs on the two subchannels of one rank. mapping.policy: cost (compare estimates), npu or pim (every group); mapping.overrides: weight-name substring -> npu | pim, longest match first.
